subject: Pioneer Health — tenant access & initial keying handoff

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pioneer Health — tenant access & initial keying handoff

Hi Sara — great to connect last week. We want to get the implementation/CS handoff started so Pioneer Health can begin testing the Redwood inference endpoints next week.

High-level ask: please confirm who should be the initial admin users (2 recommended), and whether Pioneer prefers that Redwood seeds an initial service API key+project namespace, or if your team will self-seed via the admin console.

What we'd like to cover in the kickoff: 
- Tenant name / canonical org id to use
- Admin users (emails and roles)
- API key seeding vs self-provision
- Project/namespace naming and initial quotas
- Any compliance/KMS requirements (we support customer-managed KMS)

I've attached a short pre-install checklist to speed things up. David (implementation lead) and Monica (CS) are copied — they'll run the technical handoff and invite flow. Irene will handle API key rotation/setup.

Proposed times for a 30-min kickoff: Tue 3/17 10:00-10:30 PT, Wed 3/18 14:00-14:30 PT. Tell us what works and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — excited to get you onboarded.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pioneer Health — tenant access & initial keying handoff

Hi Ben / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. 

Short answers: we can provide two admin users (me and Markus) and our infra lead (eng-team@pioneerhealth.com) will be the technical contact. Pioneer would prefer Redwood seed the initial service account and API key so we can avoid a delay while we create access on our side — we can rotate keys after initial validation. For compliance, we do use AWS KMS (same account as our infra) and will want to discuss CMK access during the call.

Availability: Wed 3/18 14:00 PT works best. Please send an invite to eng-team@pioneerhealth.com as well.

Attached is a procurement/PO placeholder so your finance team can see our timeline.

Sara Li
Director, Data Platforms | Pioneer Health

Subject: RE: Pioneer Health — tenant access & initial keying handoff

Thanks Sara — glad to hear Wed 3/18 14:00 PT works. I've penciled it in and will send a calendar invite after confirming with our calendar server.

Quick runbook for the meeting so we can be efficient:
1) Confirm Tenant canonical name: please confirm the short org id you want (e.g., pioneer-health-prod).
2) Admin invites: we will invite the two admin emails you provided (Sara Li, Markus Vogel) and seed one service account API key scoped to a single project/namespace for initial testing.
3) KMS: we support bringing your CMK. For the kickoff we'll identify the ARN and note any grant/role we need; procurement/infra can follow up with access.
4) Quotas & rate limits: we'll set a pilot quota (100k tokens/day burstable to 200k) which you can adjust after the first week.

If Pioneer prefers to self-seed keys, we can walk you through the admin flow in the call and hand the keys over to your security team.

Attaching our initial tenant template (JSON) so you can see the exact fields we'll populate during provisioning. Please review the namespace naming and let us know if you need changes before Wed.

Subject: Re: Pioneer Health — tenant access & initial keying handoff

Sara / team — hi, Monica here from CS. A couple of practical items to have ready for the call so we can complete provisioning in one session: 

- Confirm org display name and canonical id (this will be the namespace prefix).
- Provide the two admin emails (Sara and Markus OK) and an alternate backup (in case 2FA blocks initial invite).
- Confirm whether you want SSO (SAML/OIDC) setup in parallel — if so, please share IdP metadata or indicate that you want email invites first and SSO later.
- If Redwood will seed keys, confirm which AWS account/CMK ARN we should use and if we should create a cross-account grant or use a service role.

FYI: for seeded keys we will create a scoped service account with admin:project:create and admin:keys:read for the first 7 days; we recommend rotating keys immediately after testing.

Also attaching a brief checklist we use during handoffs — it contains the admin invite steps and the typical invite cadence.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: pioneer_handshake_checklist.pdf (stub)
